summary: Implemented the endpoint-ruleset builtin helper; nothing committed. Changes: (1) botocore/regions.py: added `import enum` and the EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, enum.Enum) class with the eleven members and per-member comments. (2) botocore/args.py: imported the enum as EPRBuiltins after botocore.endpoint; made _should_set_global_sts_endpoint accept endpoint_config=None (no variant tags); added public compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults after _ensure_boolean, reusing the bridge's FIPS and DualStack lookups and the existing S3/STS predicates. (3) tests/unit/test_args.py: added TestEndpointResolverBuiltins covering each behavioral criterion, with one custom-data legacy test, one bundled-data test, and a mocked S3 predicate test asserting one call. Verification: args, client, and regions unit tests pass (415 passed) using the shared venv interpreter. Not verified: black and isort were not runnable in the shared venv, so formatting was checked by hand for the 79-column limit. The only over-length line (botocore/args.py:315) predates this change. Choices: SDK::Endpoint is always a key, with value None when absent; the helper calls two underscore-prefixed bridge methods to get the required precedence.
